text: Hey all, can someone clarify the parental leave policy for PTY LTD folks? I’m looking at the Benefits > Parental Leave section but it’s a bit confusing. Mainly wondering about how much leave we get and if it’s paid or unpaid? Thanks!

Hi Elena! Sure, happy to help. So for PTY LTD, you get up to 12 months of unpaid parental leave if you’ve been here at least a year. You can actually request another 12 months unpaid on top of that, so potentially 2 years total. 

For pay, there’s the Australian Government Parental Leave Pay scheme—if you’re eligible, you can get up to 22 weeks paid at the national minimum wage. That’s separate from GitLab’s own parental leave, which can sometimes overlap depending on your situation. You can apply for the gov’t pay up to 3 months before your due date. 

Just make sure to put your leave dates into Workday under ‘Parental Leave’ when you’re ready. Hope that helps!
That’s super clear, thanks Chloe! Appreciate the quick rundown.
Thanks Chloe, this is really helpful. I was wondering about this too!
